title: Structure Of Modern English I
modules: The Structure Of The Sound System
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the fact that many English word are of the Latin or Greek origin."
Much more important is the fact that many English word are of the Latin or Greek origin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are called allophones; allophones do not cause a change in meaning if replaced by another allophone."
Variations of a phoneme are called allophones; allophones do not cause a change in meaning if replaced by another allophone.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the smallest sound segment that is significant and can cause a change in meaning if replaced by another sound."
A phoneme is the smallest sound segment that is significant and can cause a change in meaning if replaced by another sound.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the correspondence between the form of the verb and our concept of time."
Tense is the correspondence between the form of the verb and our concept of time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the major forms of affixation and therefore major morphological processes in English."
Prefixation and suffixation are the major forms of affixation and therefore major morphological processes in English.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the word or group of words that tells us what or whom the speaker or writer is talking about."
The subject is the word or group of words that tells us what or whom the speaker or writer is talking about.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of creating new words from the initial letters of existing words."
Acronymy is the process of creating new words from the initial letters of existing words.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the unit of pronunciation while the morpheme is the smallest unit of meaning and of grammatical analysis."
The syllable is the unit of pronunciation while the morpheme is the smallest unit of meaning and of grammatical analysis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most useful and most brilliant of human inventions."
Language is one of the most useful and most brilliant of human inventions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to lifeless things or things that are not capable of reproduction."
Neuter gender refers to lifeless things or things that are not capable of reproduction.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used for a statement and another one used for a question and a request."
A certain tune is used for a statement and another one used for a question and a request.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to items that are separable into identifiable or numerable units while Non-Count or Uncountable nouns are mass nouns which cannot be expressed in terms of singular and plural."

Count or Countable nouns refer to items that are separable into identifiable or numerable units while Non-Count or Uncountable nouns are mass nouns which cannot be expressed in terms of singular and plural.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a very important word class in any language."
The verb is a very important word class in any language.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a set of more than one word."
A group refers to a set of more than one word.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of {dance} and the progressive marker {ing} while gracefully also contains two morphemes: {grace} and the derivational morphemes {- ful} and {-ly}."
Dancing is made up of {dance} and the progressive marker {ing} while gracefully also contains two morphemes: {grace} and the derivational morphemes {- ful} and {-ly}.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the capability of human language users to produce an infinite number of words and utterances using the word formation rules of languages."
Creativity refers to the capability of human language users to produce an infinite number of words and utterances using the word formation rules of languages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a set of items with similar characteristics."
Class refers to a set of items with similar characteristics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when two entities are involved while the superlative degree is applied when more than two entities are compared."
The comparative degree is used when two entities are involved while the superlative degree is applied when more than two entities are compared.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of one or more clauses; the clause is made up of one or more groups; the group is made up of one or more words and every word consists of one or more morphemes."
The sentence is made up of one or more clauses; the clause is made up of one or more groups; the group is made up of one or more words and every word consists of one or more morphemes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the government by one person."
An autocracy is the government by one person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the emphasis on a syllable which makes the syllable prominent and louder than the other syllables in the word or utterance."
Stress is the emphasis on a syllable which makes the syllable prominent and louder than the other syllables in the word or utterance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the smallest meaningful unit of grammatical analysis."
A morpheme is the smallest meaningful unit of grammatical analysis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the rise and fall of the voice during speech."
Intonation refers to the rise and fall of the voice during speech.
fib: ______ is the obligatory part of the syllable, thus there are as many syllables as there are vowels in an utterance.
nucleus
The nucleus is the obligatory part of the syllable, thus there are as many syllables as there are vowels in an utterance.
______ is used for Yes / No questions, lists, mixed clauses, additional remarks and for pitch contrast.
tune
Tune Two - the rising tune is used for Yes / No questions, lists, mixed clauses, additional remarks and for pitch contrast.
______ is a group of words with a subject and a predicate which can modify other structures and also function as a part of speech.
clause
A clause is a group of words with a subject and a predicate which can modify other structures and also function as a part of speech.
______ is a morphological process involving the addition of a morpheme to a root or base.
Suffixation
Suffixation is a morphological process involving the addition of a morpheme to a root or base.
______ is a subordinate clause that functions as an adjective.
adjectival clause
An adjectival clause is a subordinate clause that functions as an adjective.
______ is a variant of a morpheme which occurs in a specific environment.
allomorph
An allomorph is a variant of a morpheme which occurs in a specific environment.
______ are called by the classes of words to which they belong.
Phrases
Phrases are called by the classes of words to which they belong.
______ refers to nouns that denote both male and female.
Common gender
Common gender refers to nouns that denote both male and female.
______ is a short speech introducing a play.
prologue
A prologue is a short speech introducing a play.
______ is a pronoun that joins an adjectival clause to some word in the independent or main clause.
relative pronoun
A relative pronoun is a pronoun that joins an adjectival clause to some word in the independent or main clause.
______ is a morpheme that is attached at the beginning of a root.
prefix
A prefix is a morpheme that is attached at the beginning of a root.
______ are made up of sounds which are grouped together for pronunciation purposes.
Syllables
Syllables are made up of sounds which are grouped together for pronunciation purposes.
______ is a simple sentence when it stands alone.
independent clause
An independent clause is a simple sentence when it stands alone.
______ is used to analyse all the units except the morpheme.
Structure
Structure is used to analyse all the units except the morpheme.
______ are the Nigerian creations 'go-slow', for-one-nine' and 'ecomoging' a word inflected from ECOMOG which means 'conveying' of votes from place to place' (Newswatch, March 16, 1992:6).
Examples
Examples are the Nigerian creations 'go-slow', for-one-nine' and 'ecomoging' a word inflected from ECOMOG which means 'conveying' of votes from place to place' (Newswatch, March 16, 1992:6).
______ are those whose utterances can be divided into feet which are isochronous (i.e. of equal length).
Languages with stress-timed rhythm
Languages with stress-timed rhythm are those whose utterances can be divided into feet which are isochronous (i.e. of equal length).
______ is the predicator element in a clause whether it operates in a dependent or independent clause.
verbal group
The verbal group is the predicator element in a clause whether it operates in a dependent or independent clause.
______ is a prepositional phrase that modifies a noun or pronoun.
adjectival phrase
Adjectival Phrase An adjectival phrase is a prepositional phrase that modifies a noun or pronoun.
______ is a very important way of creating new words in English.
Note Compounding
Note Compounding is a very important way of creating new words in English.
______ refers to a set of more than one word which can function as a part of speech or word class.
group or phrase
A group or phrase refers to a set of more than one word which can function as a part of speech or word class.
______ is a member of the Open class; it occurs as singular or plural; masculine, feminine or neuter gender and in the subjective, objective or possessive case.
noun in English
The noun in English is a member of the Open class; it occurs as singular or plural; masculine, feminine or neuter gender and in the subjective, objective or possessive case.
______ is a group of words with a subject and a predicate which functions as an adverb.
adverbial clause
An adverbial clause is a group of words with a subject and a predicate which functions as an adverb.
